Allow configuring different connection limits across separate IPC listening sockets
reviewability: All prior objections resolved with multiple approvals on the latest code
agreement: Strong support with no open objections across multiple reviewers
Tested connection limits and backlog behavior locally on Linux and macOS (xyzconstant)
